title: LockMode
description: Pin a subtree to a fixed color mode (always dark or always light) regardless of the document mode.

tool.name: mount_lock_mode
tool.description: Mount a LockMode demo showing always-dark and always-light regions side by side.

props.name: mode
props.desc: The color mode to lock this subtree to. Pinned at mount.

props.name: class
props.desc: Optional CSS class forwarded to the wrapper div.

props.name: children
props.desc: Content rendered inside the locked region.

attrs.desc: Static attribute on the wrapper div matching the locked mode. The lockMode action keeps this set.
Mirrored from document root by MutationObserver so @rokkit/themes component CSS keys work inside the region.
